newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFM says will invest $425 mln in Mexico railroad.
newsitem.headline: GFM says will invest $425 mln in Mexico railroad.

text.p: Grupo Ferroviario Mexicano (GFM) will invest $425 million in the next five years to revitalize the Pacific-North rail line, company director Alfredo Casar told reporters.
"We have an investment plan of about $425 million for the next five years," he said.
Those funds will be used to obtain locomotives and boxcars and to improve the railroad's infrastructure, he said.
On July 4, GFM obtained 100 percent of the shares of Pacific-North with a bid of $527 million. It also won the concession to run the Chihuahya-Pacific railroad.
GFM is a consortium of Grupo Mexico, S.A., Union Pacific, and ICA, S.A..
